Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly introduced EMI and Universal Music Group into the analysis, which are distribution companies, not the parent company of Apple Records. This led to potential confusion and an incorrect conclusion that Apple Records is part of UMG, when the correct parent company is Apple Corps Ltd. This step introduced unnecessary complexity and misdirection, affecting the final result.
